business_problem: The company needed to move away from legacy on-premise hardware and previous cloud environments that suffered from high maintenance costs, scalability bottlenecks during peak holiday remittance periods, and slow software delivery cycles.
solution_summary: The modernized architecture leverages managed serverless compute services to handle fluctuating transaction volumes dynamically. Mission-critical teller workflows and operations portals run on App Engine , while asynchronous transaction queues, background processing, and partner integration pipelines run on Cloud Run and Cloud Run functions . Container images and deployments are securely managed using Artifact Registry . Operational data and business insights flow through , orchestrated by Cloud Scheduler to generate automated performance reporting. Parallel to its infrastructure modernization, M Lhuillier deployed across its enterprise and launched the Gemini Champions program. Supported by Symph-led ‘AI in Workspace’ workshops, the initiative recorded over 1.6 million interactions across 1,400+ active unique users in its first 60 days, spanning 13 apps and 82 distinct action types.
